636.title: Stock count sheet screen and the below-minimum list
humanItems: Dandan counts ten real products on a phone, in crates and in kilos, leaves the screen in the middle, comes back to the draft and closes it: the sheet is comfortable to use with one hand and the numbers in the below-minimum list are the ones he expects.

637.title: Stock count by voice or text: a draft on the count sheet
humanItems: Dandan counts one real shelf by voice on his phone, in Hebrew, with crates and kilos: the suggested rows are the products he named, with the amounts he said; what he fixed by hand is saved as he fixed it.
